greeting.desc: A short first line spoken before any loan talk: the agent's name and company (often with a recording disclosure), usually ending in an identity check or a pending-EMI hook, with no amounts or loan details until the right person is confirmed.

sections.title: Persona / Who you are
sections.desc: Defines the agent's name, role, company, gender and voice (warm, calm, firm and respectful, never threatening), and when to say it is a virtual assistant.

sections.title: Environment & Situation
sections.desc: Describes the outbound call setting, who may answer (borrower, family, wrong number, voicemail), and the borrower profile and context.

sections.title: Objective
sections.desc: Ranks the call goals from payment on this call, to a time-bound promise, to a callback, and says every call ends with one outcome and a closing.
aliases: What you want from the call

sections.title: Non-negotiable Rules
sections.desc: Hard guardrails checked every turn: identity gate, no threats, waivers or invented figures, payment-channel limits, do-not-call, abuse, death and distress handling, and the calling-hours window.

sections.title: Speaking Style
sections.desc: Controls spoken output: short turns, one question per turn, numbers and dates in words, Hinglish and language matching, female self-reference, how the customer's name is used, no repetition, and no markdown.

sections.title: Inputs, Variables & Tools
sections.desc: Lists the call variables (name, EMI, overdue amount, DPD, dates, prior context, link status), which are required or optional, what may be spoken, and the tools the agent can call.

sections.title: Opening & Identity Verification
sections.desc: Confirms the person is the borrower before any loan detail is shared, covering re-ask limits, third parties and wrong numbers, machines, and phone handover.

sections.title: Conversation Flow (Debt Anchor, Payment Ask & Link)
sections.desc: The main collections flow once identity is confirmed: state the pending amount using the history, ask for payment today, send and guide the payment link on the call, then confirm any promise.

sections.title: Objections, Refusals & Fallback Ladder
sections.desc: Handles stalling, refusal, hardship and requests for more time with a limited number of persuasion attempts, then steps down from full amount to partial payment to a short time-boxed promise or callback.
aliases: When they can't pay right now

sections.title: Special Situations
sections.desc: Handles non-standard cases: already-paid or auto-debit claims, merchant or fraud disputes, grievances, legal mentions, manager requests, settlement asks, distress and do-not-call.

sections.title: Closings & Dispositions
sections.desc: Gives the fixed closing line for each outcome (paid, promise, callback, wrong number, refusal, sensitive and others), the disposition to log, and the rule that the call ends with end_interaction.
